description: Storage v2 BidiReadObject with three ranges, the second starting past the end of a 10-byte object: the status of the failing range and of the other pending ranges in BidiReadObjectError. Read handles are opaque and ignored. Checks SPEC-GRPC-PENDING-RANGES.

local_choice.reason: Recorded 2026-11-17: Cloud Storage refuses BidiReadObject for the recording project with PERMISSION_DENIED GRPC_BIDI_READ_OBJECT_NOT_ALLOWLISTED, so the pending-range question stays open; gcs-mimic serves the RPC and reports the range past the end as OUT_OF_RANGE (SPEC-GRPC-PENDING-RANGES).
